name: Emote Tower 💃
desc:
🎵 Welcome to Emote Troll Tower! 😈

💃 Climb the Tower with Emotes and unlock Gears as you go! 
🎲 Gain a new Gear every 15 minutes!
😹 Use your gear to troll others, cause mayhem, or just survive the climb!

🎁 Like 👍 and Favorite ⭐ the game to unlock exclusive in-game rewards!
🚪 Join the group to access a secret teleport zone and more surprises!

🏆 Can you reach the top of the Troll Tower?
✨ New Emotes coming soon! 🎵
